_comment: Coordinates in cluster_face.png pixels (1490x687). Angles in degrees from the 3 o'clock direction, clockwise positive. The face is cropped to the three round dials, keeping the speedometer's own bezel whole, and padded top and bottom with the housing so its proportions match a phone in landscape and it reaches every edge. Fuel and coolant arcs fall outside the crop; both are shown as readouts instead.

readouts._comment: coolant and voltage sit where the turn-signal arrows are; fuel uses the housing strip under the speedometer and only appears when the car reports it.
